name: joi-form-i18n
what: Turns Joi validation errors into one ready-to-show message per form field, in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Arabic, Hindi or Urdu, with translatable field names and RTL detection.
useful: Teams with international users get translated form errors without writing their own message tables, and without replacing Joi.
gap: Joi ships English-only messages; existing glue packages target other libraries or frameworks, so there is no small Joi-focused helper that returns per-field translated form errors.
checklist: Returns one translated message per field for each built-in language
Regional codes fall back to the base language
All locales define the same keys and keep placeholders (tested)
